description: Account Aggregator directory entry — community-maintained registry of AA identities, handle suffixes and endpoints for client-side multi-AA routing.

handles.description: VUA handle suffixes served by this AA (without '@'), e.g. 'finvu'. Longest-suffix match wins at resolution.

fiTypes.description: FI types this AA serves, when constrained.

status.description: Operational status per public sources; 'unknown' until verified.
